I’ll check the available knowledge base first, then verify the video’s content directly if needed.

```python
knowledge_result = await knowledge_search_knowledge("YouTube video L1vXCYZAYYM highest number of bird species on camera simultaneously", scope="session")
print(knowledge_result)
```
The knowledge base did not provide the answer, so I’m searching for indexed references to the video and its bird-count claim.
```python
search_result = await web_search("L1vXCYZAYYM highest number bird species on camera simultaneously", max_results=10)
print(search_result)
```
I’ll now inspect the video page and any transcript or description references, using the exact video URL.
```python
video_page = await web_fetch("https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM", max_chars=20000)
print(video_page)
```
I’m checking transcript-oriented sources and indexed captions for the video ID, since the answer depends on the maximum simultaneous species count rather than the total species shown.
```python
transcript_search = await web_search("\"L1vXCYZAYYM\" transcript birds", max_results=10)
print(transcript_search)
```
If captions are available, extracting them is the most reliable way to locate the stated maximum. I’ll query the public YouTube metadata/captions with a command-line extractor.
```python
command_output = await run_command("yt-dlp --skip-download --write-auto-subs --write-subs --sub-langs 'en.*' --sub-format vtt --print '%(title)s' 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM'")
print(command_output)
```
I’m inspecting the returned search and page data for a title, transcript link, or explicit count.
```python
inspection = {
    "search_type": type(search_result).__name__,
    "search_preview": str(search_result)[:5000],
    "page_type": type(video_page).__name__,
    "page_preview": str(video_page)[:5000],
    "transcript_search_preview": str(transcript_search)[:5000],
    "command_preview": str(command_output)[:5000],
}
print(inspection)
```
The indexed results are insufficiently explicit, so I’m querying YouTube’s oEmbed metadata and caption endpoints for the video title and available subtitles.
```python
oembed = await web_fetch("https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM&format=json", max_chars=5000)
print(oembed)
```
```python
targeted_search = await web_search("\"what is the highest number\" \"bird species\" \"on camera simultaneously\"", max_results=10)
print(targeted_search)
```
I’m making one final direct check of the video’s machine-readable metadata for captions, which should contain the spoken answer if it is stated aloud.
```python
metadata_output = await run_command("python -c \"import urllib.request; u='https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM'; print(urllib.request.urlopen(u).read().decode('utf-8','ignore')[:20000])\"")
print(metadata_output)
```
I’ll download the audio and transcribe it locally if the video exposes a playable stream; this avoids relying on incomplete web indexing.
```python
download_status = await run_command("yt-dlp -x --audio-format mp3 -o './video_audio.%(ext)s' 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM' 2>&1 | tail -20")
print(download_status)
```
If the audio download is unavailable, I’ll use YouTube’s transcript API as a fallback.
```python
install_status = await run_command("uv pip install youtube-transcript-api")
print(install_status)
```
The transcript client is installed; I’m querying all available caption tracks and searching the text for the simultaneous-species count.
```python
transcript_output = await run_command("python -c \"from youtube_transcript_api import YouTubeTranscriptApi; x=YouTubeTranscriptApi().fetch('L1vXCYZAYYM'); print('\\n'.join(i.text for i in x))\"")
print(transcript_output)
```
I’m checking a public transcript mirror directly for the same video ID.
```python
mirror_transcript = await web_fetch("https://youtubetranscript.com/?server_vid2=L1vXCYZAYYM", max_chars=30000)
print(mirror_transcript)
```
```python
final_search = await web_search("\"L1vXCYZAYYM\" bird species", max_results=20)
print(final_search)
```
Five bird species.
